units.source_text: 回到邸内，但闻哭声震天。

en.t: When they returned to the mansion, all they heard was weeping loud enough to shake the heavens.

units.source_text: 时值夜半，想邀请比叡山住持及诸僧众来做功德，也急切难行。

en.t: Since it was the middle of the night, it was difficult to summon the abbot of Mount Hiei and the monks at once to perform rites for merit.

units.source_text: 安产后虽然病体尚未复健，但是看来必无危险，因此大家都已放心。

en.t: After the safe delivery, although her body had not yet fully recovered, there seemed to be no danger, so everyone had already felt relieved.

units.source_text: 冷不防突然逝世，仿佛青天一个霹雳，邸内诸人都吓丧了胆。

en.t: Her sudden death without warning was like a thunderclap from a clear sky, and everyone in the mansion was terrified out of their wits.

units.source_text: 此时各处吊客络绎不绝地来了。

en.t: At this time, mourners began arriving one after another from every direction.

units.source_text: 家人无法对付，手忙脚乱，混乱不堪。

en.t: The household could not cope with them and fell into frantic, utter confusion.

units.source_text: 诸亲人哭泣之哀，旁人听了也都肝肠断绝！

en.t: The grief in the relatives' sobbing was so unbearable that even bystanders felt their hearts torn apart when they heard it.

units.source_text: 葵姬过去屡次被鬼怪所袭而一时昏迷，但后来渐渐苏醒。

en.t: In the past, Lady Aoi had often been attacked by spirits and fallen unconscious for a time, but afterward she had gradually awakened again.

units.source_text: 家人疑心此次也会复苏，因此枕头也不移动，静候了两三日。

en.t: The household suspected that she might revive this time as well, so they did not even move her pillow and quietly waited for two or three days.

units.source_text: 然而容颜逐渐走样，证明确已长逝。

en.t: Yet her appearance gradually changed, proving that she had indeed passed away for good.

units.source_text: 绝望之余，家人无不痛心疾首！

en.t: In their despair, every member of the household was stricken with bitter anguish.

units.source_text: 源氏公子除了痛惜葵姬之死而外，又为六条妃子之事伤心，觉得人生于世，实甚无聊。

en.t: Prince Genji not only grieved deeply over Lady Aoi's death, but was also heartbroken over the matter of the Rokujo lady, and he felt that life in this world was truly empty.

units.source_text: 关系密切的诸亲友的殷勤吊慰，他也觉得毫不足贵了。

en.t: Even the attentive condolences of close relatives and friends seemed to him to have no worth at all.
